messages:
maria_cs: FYI BridgeFlow reserved pool ready. Plan: 1200 slots, steady QPS 340, burst 700. Need priming duration, autoscale tune, and 02:00-05:00 UTC run window.

sam_se: My suggestion: 72h priming. Proposed autoscale: min=2, target_qps_per_replica=60, scale_up=0.6, cooldown=60s.

leila_sre: +1 72h. Also set stabilization_window=90s and max_replicas=18. Lower batching to 16 for latency smoothing. I'll monitor p50/p90/p99, GPU util, and queue depth.

tom_ops: Ops will run window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Keep burst enabled first 45m then disable to validate autoscale. Rollback plan: immediate traffic-shift to shared pool; I'll own.

nora_pm: I'll prep customer-facing 24h/48h health reports and short survey. Renewal-risk trigger: p99 > 800ms for >10% at 24h.

ci-bot: Load test slots reserved: 2025-09-10T02:00:00Z and 2025-09-11T02:00:00Z. Harness: https://ci.redwood/tests/bridgeflow-prime :robot_face:

maria_cs: Action items: sam_se start 72h priming and paste logs; leila_sre apply autoscale edits; tom_ops confirm runbook commands; nora_pm schedule health checks. React with :white_check_mark: when ack.
sam_se: Ack :white_check_mark:
